messages.subject: number of decimals in lavInspect(model,"vcov")
parts:
Hello,

I build in lavaan  a (multiple indicators) latent growth curve model in order to investigate gene by environment interactions in temperament development. 
Now have a problem when aiming to plot the interaction effects using this webpage. http://www.quantpsy.org/interact/lca3.htm The issue is that variances and covariances of parameters are usually very small. However,  lavInspect(model,"vcov") returns 3 digits only. 

I tried options(digits=10) but it does not work. <- paste (vcov(model)) could work but there are many parameter (co)variances in a multiple indicators model and I would need to find out how to create a matrix object.

Did someone had this problem before and found a better solution? 

Thanks for your help,
Henrik

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: number of decimals in lavInspect(model,"vcov")
parts:
On 10/27/2015 09:29 AM, henrik....@upf.edu wrote:
> However, lavInspect(model,"vcov") returns 3 digits only.

You can use the argument add.class = FALSE, and you will see the full
matrix as it is displayed by R as usual.

Or you can use lavTech(), which gives the raw numbers (without any
labels or pretty-printing) by default.

Note that lavInspect and lavTech are essentially equivalent, except for
their 'default' printing options.

Yves.
